title: Kestrel Auto Finance Transport Credit on Vehicle Purchase Agreements — Finance Partner Memo
content:
**Credit.** Under Vehicle Purchase Agreements, an order financed through Kestrel Auto Finance earns a financing transport credit against the transfer shipping fee. The tier is that of the order's contract in Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts.

| Tier of the order's Kestrel Auto Finance contract | Financing transport credit |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Finance Tier A or Kestrel Finance Tier A+ | $90.00 (the prime financing credit) |
| Kestrel Finance Tier B or Kestrel Finance Tier C | $50.00 (the near-prime financing credit) |
| Kestrel Finance Tier D or Kestrel Finance Tier E | none |
| order not financed through Kestrel Auto Finance | none |

The credit is subtracted from the transfer shipping fee once the carrier price has been reduced by the program's shipping fee discount and rounded, together with anything else added to or subtracted from that discounted fee, and the result is never below zero.

**Questions answered.**

*An order paid through an outside lender?* It is not financed through Kestrel Auto Finance; no credit.

*A Tier C contract and a discounted transfer price of $499.00?* The fee becomes $449.00.

*A Tier A+ contract and a discounted transfer price of $60.00?* $60.00 less $90.00 would go below zero; the fee is $0.00.
